title: Breaking Out of a jsonb Literal
description: A filter built a PostgreSQL jsonb array by pasting user input into a JSON string, so the escape was out of a JSON document and a cast, and a row count was the only thing that ever answered back.

title: The Second Form Nobody Reviewed
description: A support contact form was hardened against stored HTML. The business partnership form on the same API, feeding a different internal dashboard, was not.

title: Push Notifications for an Account That Wasn't Mine
description: A notification API authenticated every request, then took the account to act on from a field in the JSON body.
